_color_note: COLOR = whose voice. White = Alex's own voice. Yellow = a different voice (live Q&A guest, or Alex impersonating a customer/objection). Drive via the style stream's per-word 'c' or top-level voice_spans.
_layout_note: y 50% = mid-frame, DATA-DRIVEN (2026-06-10): measured across Oliver's 24 workshop Q&A clips (599 shots, training/height_study) — his overall median caption-Y is ~49.7%, his dominant medium/closeup tight-shot anchor is ~50%, and he NEVER goes below ~50%. (Old 55 sat too low.) This static default is for renders with NO layout track; when a layout track IS present (caption-app, and /edit which now runs layout_analyze on its reframed output), each shot's Y is per-angle: WIDE 45% / TIGHT 50%. Chunk caps LOCKED: <=18 displayed chars AND <=3 words, hard-broken at every sentence (.?!) and clause (,). For 1080x1920 set video 1080x1920 and font_size_px ~75.
_alex_note: LOCKED 2026-06-11: Alex single-cam desk/talking-head caption height. Use with spice_caption --no-layout so this STATIC y is honored (the per-angle analyzer otherwise forces ~50% = too high). y58 renders ~59% = top of tank-top V / lav-mic line. Approved by Maddex on StayInAGreatMood.
_chin_note: y78 = below-chin placement for TIGHT podcast/interview CUs where the face fills the frame and y58 lands on the beard/mouth (2026-06-28).
name: spice
_what: Dynamic 'spice' pro captions — reverse-engineered from Oliver (the team's best editor). The locked pro_locked/alex_canon path is single-axis (Regular->Extrabold weight + optional yellow numbers). THIS path is multi-axis: a full Proxima Nova weight palette used as an emphasis dial, gentle (un-leaned) italics, and per-word voice color.
